SELECT uuid, board_type, layout_id, setter_id, setter_username, name, description,
        hsm, edge_left, edge_right, edge_bottom, edge_top, angle, frames_count, frames_pace, frames,
        is_draft, is_listed, is_hidden, created_at, published_at, user_id, required_set_ids, compatible_size_ids,
        characteristics, hold_fingerprint, missing_hold_count, retired_by_reset, revision_number, holds_revision_number,
        updated_at, sync_seq, updated_at AS __updated_at, sync_seq AS __seq
    FROM board_climbs
    WHERE (board_type = $1) AND COALESCE(((board_climbs.user_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM content_privacy orphan_privacy WHERE orphan_privacy.entity_type = $2::text AND orphan_privacy.entity_id = board_climbs.uuid)) OR $3 = board_climbs.user_id OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM users privacy_owner
    LEFT JOIN user_profiles privacy_profile ON privacy_profile.user_id = privacy_owner.id
    LEFT JOIN content_privacy privacy_content ON privacy_content.entity_type = $4::text
      AND privacy_content.entity_id = board_climbs.uuid AND privacy_content.owner_id = privacy_owner.id
    WHERE privacy_owner.id = board_climbs.user_id AND CASE
      WHEN privacy_content.audience = 'only_me' THEN false
      WHEN privacy_content.audience = 'followers' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_follows privacy_follow WHERE privacy_follow.follower_id = $5 AND privacy_follow.following_id = board_climbs.user_id)
      WHEN NOT COALESCE(privacy_profile.is_private, false) THEN true
      WHEN privacy_content.audience = 'public' AND privacy_content.public_consent_revision = privacy_profile.privacy_revision THEN true
      ELSE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_follows privacy_follow WHERE privacy_follow.follower_id = $6 AND privacy_follow.following_id = board_climbs.user_id) END
  )), false)
      AND (updated_at, sync_seq) > ($7::timestamp, $8::bigint)
      AND updated_at < now() - make_interval(secs => $9)
    ORDER BY updated_at ASC, sync_seq ASC
    LIMIT $10

    FROM board_climbs
    WHERE (board_type = $1 AND layout_id = $2 AND compatible_size_ids @> ARRAY[$3]::int[]) AND COALESCE(((board_climbs.user_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM content_privacy orphan_privacy WHERE orphan_privacy.entity_type = $4::text AND orphan_privacy.entity_id = board_climbs.uuid)) OR $5 = board_climbs.user_id OR EXISTS (

SELECT board_type, climb_uuid, angle, display_difficulty, benchmark_difficulty,
        ascensionist_count, difficulty_average, quality_average, CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM board_climbs privacy_fa_owned WHERE privacy_fa_owned.board_type = board_climb_stats.board_type
      AND privacy_fa_owned.uuid = board_climb_stats.climb_uuid
      AND (privacy_fa_owned.user_id IS NOT NULL OR privacy_fa_owned.is_boardsesh_authored)
  ) THEN (
    SELECT CASE WHEN (COALESCE(((privacy_fa_tick.user_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM content_privacy orphan_privacy WHERE orphan_privacy.entity_type = $1::text AND orphan_privacy.entity_id = privacy_fa_tick.uuid)) OR $2 = privacy_fa_tick.user_id OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM users privacy_owner
    LEFT JOIN user_profiles privacy_profile ON privacy_profile.user_id = privacy_owner.id
    LEFT JOIN content_privacy privacy_content ON privacy_content.entity_type = $3::text
      AND privacy_content.entity_id = privacy_fa_tick.uuid AND privacy_content.owner_id = privacy_owner.id
    WHERE privacy_owner.id = privacy_fa_tick.user_id AND CASE
      WHEN privacy_content.audience = 'only_me' THEN false
      WHEN privacy_content.audience = 'followers' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_follows privacy_follow WHERE privacy_follow.follower_id = $4 AND privacy_follow.following_id = privacy_fa_tick.user_id)
      WHEN NOT COALESCE(privacy_profile.is_private, false) THEN true
      WHEN privacy_content.audience = 'public' AND privacy_content.public_consent_revision = privacy_profile.privacy_revision THEN true
      ELSE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_follows privacy_follow WHERE privacy_follow.follower_id = $5 AND privacy_follow.following_id = privacy_fa_tick.user_id) END
  )), false)
    AND (privacy_fa_tick.user_id = $6 OR (
      (privacy_fa_tick.session_id IS NULL OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT privacy_session.id AS id, privacy_session.created_by_user_id AS owner_id,
      CASE WHEN privacy_session.is_public THEN 'public' ELSE 'invite_only' END AS audience FROM board_sessions privacy_session) privacy_resource
    LEFT JOIN resource_privacy privacy_override ON privacy_override.kind = $7 AND privacy_override.resource_id = privacy_resource.id
    LEFT JOIN resource_grants privacy_grant ON privacy_grant.kind = $8 AND privacy_grant.resource_id = privacy_resource.id AND privacy_grant.user_id = $9
    WHERE privacy_resource.id = privacy_fa_tick.session_id AND (
      privacy_resource.owner_id = $10 OR (
        COALESCE(privacy_grant.status, 'pending') <> 'revoked' AND (
          COALESCE(privacy_override.audience, privacy_resource.audience) IN ('public', 'unlisted') OR (
            COALESCE(privacy_override.audience, privacy_resource.audience) <> 'only_me' AND (
              privacy_grant.status = 'approved' OR (privacy_override.resource_id IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM board_session_participants legacy_participant WHERE legacy_participant.session_id = privacy_resource.id AND legacy_participant.user_id = $11)) OR (
                (COALESCE(privacy_override.audience, privacy_resource.audience) = 'followers' OR COALESCE(privacy_override.inherit_followers, false))
                AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_follows privacy_follow WHERE privacy_follow.follower_id = $12 AND privacy_follow.following_id = privacy_resource.owner_id)
              )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )) AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM (
      SELECT privacy_parent_session.board_id FROM board_sessions privacy_parent_session
      WHERE privacy_parent_session.id = privacy_fa_tick.session_id AND privacy_parent_session.board_id IS NOT NULL
      UNION SELECT privacy_parent_membership.board_id FROM session_boards privacy_parent_membership
      WHERE privacy_parent_membership.session_id = privacy_fa_tick.session_id
      UNION SELECT privacy_named_board.id FROM (SELECT privacy_path_source.id,
    regexp_replace(regexp_replace(trim(both '/' from privacy_path_source.board_path), '/+', '/', 'g'), '^[a-z]{2}/', '') AS path
    FROM board_sessions privacy_path_source) privacy_named_session
      LEFT JOIN user_boards privacy_named_board ON privacy_named_board.slug = split_part(privacy_named_session.path, '/', 2)
        AND privacy_named_board.deleted_at IS NULL
      WHERE privacy_named_session.id = privacy_fa_tick.session_id AND split_part(privacy_named_session.path, '/', 1) = 'b'
      UNION SELECT privacy_spray_board.id FROM (SELECT privacy_path_source.id,
    regexp_replace(regexp_replace(trim(both '/' from privacy_path_source.board_path), '/+', '/', 'g'), '^[a-z]{2}/', '') AS path
    FROM board_sessions privacy_path_source) privacy_spray_session
      LEFT JOIN spray_walls privacy_spray_wall ON privacy_spray_wall.layout_id = CASE
        WHEN split_part(privacy_spray_session.path, '/', 2) ~ '^[0-9]{1,18}$'
        THEN split_part(privacy_spray_session.path, '/', 2)::bigint ELSE NULL END
        AND privacy_spray_wall.deleted_at IS NULL
      LEFT JOIN user_boards privacy_spray_board ON privacy_spray_board.uuid = privacy_spray_wall.board_uuid
        AND privacy_spray_board.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND (privacy_spray_wall.hidden_at IS NULL OR privacy_spray_board.owner_id = $13)
      WHERE privacy_spray_session.id = privacy_fa_tick.session_id AND split_part(privacy_spray_session.path, '/', 1) = 'spray'
    ) privacy_parent_refs
    LEFT JOIN user_boards privacy_parent_board ON privacy_parent_board.id = privacy_parent_refs.board_id
    WHERE privacy_parent_board.id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT privacy_board.uuid AS id, privacy_board.owner_id AS owner_id,
      CASE WHEN privacy_board.owner_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' THEN 'public' WHEN privacy_board.is_unlisted THEN 'unlisted' WHEN privacy_board.is_public THEN 'public' ELSE 'only_me' END AS audience
      FROM user_boards privacy_board WHERE privacy_board.deleted_at IS NULL) privacy_resource
    LEFT JOIN resource_privacy privacy_override ON privacy_override.kind = $14 AND privacy_override.resource_id = privacy_resource.id
    LEFT JOIN resource_grants privacy_grant ON privacy_grant.kind = $15 AND privacy_grant.resource_id = privacy_resource.id AND privacy_grant.user_id = $16
    WHERE privacy_resource.id = privacy_parent_board.uuid AND (
      privacy_resource.owner_id = $17 OR (
        COALESCE(privacy_grant.status, 'pending') <> 'revoked' AND (
          COALESCE(privacy_override.audience, privacy_resource.audience) = 'public' OR (
            COALESCE(privacy_override.audience, privacy_resource.audience) <> 'only_me' AND (
              privacy_grant.status = 'approved' OR false OR (
                (COALESCE(privacy_override.audience, privacy_resource.audience) = 'followers' OR COALESCE(privacy_override.inherit_followers, false))
                AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_follows privacy_follow WHERE privacy_follow.follower_id = $18 AND privacy_follow.following_id = privacy_resource.owner_id)
              )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    ))
  )))
      AND (privacy_fa_tick.board_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT privacy_board.uuid AS id, privacy_board.owner_id AS owner_id,
      CASE WHEN privacy_board.owner_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' THEN 'public' WHEN privacy_board.is_unlisted THEN 'unlisted' WHEN privacy_board.is_public THEN 'public' ELSE 'only_me' END AS audience
      FROM user_boards privacy_board WHERE privacy_board.deleted_at IS NULL) privacy_resource
    LEFT JOIN resource_privacy privacy_override ON privacy_override.kind = $19 AND privacy_override.resource_id = privacy_resource.id
    LEFT JOIN resource_grants privacy_grant ON privacy_grant.kind = $20 AND privacy_grant.resource_id = privacy_resource.id AND privacy_grant.user_id = $21
    WHERE privacy_resource.id = (SELECT uuid FROM user_boards privacy_fa_board WHERE privacy_fa_board.id = privacy_fa_tick.board_id) AND (
      privacy_resource.owner_id = $22 OR (
        COALESCE(privacy_grant.status, 'pending') <> 'revoked' AND (
          COALESCE(privacy_override.audience, privacy_resource.audience) IN ('public', 'unlisted') OR (
            COALESCE(privacy_override.audience, privacy_resource.audience) <> 'only_me' AND (
              privacy_grant.status = 'approved' OR false OR (
                (COALESCE(privacy_override.audience, privacy_resource.audience) = 'followers' OR COALESCE(privacy_override.inherit_followers, false))
                AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_follows privacy_follow WHERE privacy_follow.follower_id = $23 AND privacy_follow.following_id = privacy_resource.owner_id)
              )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )))
    ))) THEN COALESCE(privacy_fa_profile.display_name, privacy_fa_user.name) ELSE NULL END
    FROM boardsesh_ticks privacy_fa_tick
    JOIN board_climbs privacy_fa_climb ON privacy_fa_climb.board_type = privacy_fa_tick.board_type AND privacy_fa_climb.uuid = privacy_fa_tick.climb_uuid
    JOIN users privacy_fa_user ON privacy_fa_user.id = privacy_fa_tick.user_id
    LEFT JOIN user_profiles privacy_fa_profile ON privacy_fa_profile.user_id = privacy_fa_tick.user_id
    WHERE privacy_fa_tick.board_type = board_climb_stats.board_type AND privacy_fa_tick.climb_uuid = board_climb_stats.climb_uuid
      AND privacy_fa_tick.angle = board_climb_stats.angle AND privacy_fa_tick.status IN ('flash', 'send')
      AND privacy_fa_tick.kilter_detached_at IS NULL
      AND COALESCE(privacy_fa_tick.climb_revision, 1) >= COALESCE(privacy_fa_climb.holds_revision_number, 1)
    ORDER BY privacy_fa_tick.climbed_at ASC, privacy_fa_tick.id ASC LIMIT 1
  ) ELSE board_climb_stats.fa_username END AS fa_username, fa_at, updated_at, sync_seq, board_climb_stats.updated_at AS __updated_at, board_climb_stats.sync_seq AS __seq
    FROM board_climb_stats
    WHERE board_type = $24 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM board_climbs bc WHERE bc.uuid = board_climb_stats.climb_uuid AND bc.board_type = $25 AND COALESCE(((bc.user_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM content_privacy orphan_privacy WHERE orphan_privacy.entity_type = $26::text AND orphan_privacy.entity_id = bc.uuid)) OR $27 = bc.user_id OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM users privacy_owner
    LEFT JOIN user_profiles privacy_profile ON privacy_profile.user_id = privacy_owner.id
    LEFT JOIN content_privacy privacy_content ON privacy_content.entity_type = $28::text
      AND privacy_content.entity_id = bc.uuid AND privacy_content.owner_id = privacy_owner.id
    WHERE privacy_owner.id = bc.user_id AND CASE
      WHEN privacy_content.audience = 'only_me' THEN false
      WHEN privacy_content.audience = 'followers' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_follows privacy_follow WHERE privacy_follow.follower_id = $29 AND privacy_follow.following_id = bc.user_id)
      WHEN NOT COALESCE(privacy_profile.is_private, false) THEN true
      WHEN privacy_content.audience = 'public' AND privacy_content.public_consent_revision = privacy_profile.privacy_revision THEN true
      ELSE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_follows privacy_follow WHERE privacy_follow.follower_id = $30 AND privacy_follow.following_id = bc.user_id) END
  )), false))
      AND (board_climb_stats.updated_at, board_climb_stats.sync_seq) > ($31::timestamp, $32::bigint)
      AND board_climb_stats.updated_at < now() - make_interval(secs => $33)
    ORDER BY board_climb_stats.updated_at ASC, board_climb_stats.sync_seq ASC
    LIMIT $34
